title: 第13章 我一定要修仙第14章 无灵根修炼之法
slug: 快递通两界我带华夏全民修仙
content_zh:
李婉弯腰捡起一块巴掌大小的碎冰，瞄准五环蛇的方向，精准的砸在五环蛇的身上。
这像是打开了某种开战的开关。
五环蛇被激怒，速度极快的飞起，朝入侵的人类攻去。
男人刚刚因为激动，离变异朱火灵果最近，首当其冲的迎接了五环蛇的攻击。
“啊！”
惨叫声顿时响彻冰洞，五环蛇的毒牙瞬间刺破了衣物，扎进了男人健硕的肩膀里。
毒素在片刻之间就蔓延到了他的五脏六腑，男人嘴唇发紫，连一个声音都没办法发出就瘫在了地上。
而在五环蛇发起攻击的瞬间，李婉就拼命地跑出了冰洞。
惨叫声后，冰洞之中就陷入了诡异的安静，等了很久，洞口一直未见五环蛇的身影。
李婉探头往冰洞中看去，只见男人僵硬的躺在冰洞中，已经没了声息，而五环蛇则继续盘回了变异朱火灵果植株上。
几乎在李婉露头的那一秒，五环蛇的目光就锁在了她的身上，蛇信不断吐出，发出威胁的声音。
有了男人的前车之鉴，李婉可不会想不开的再去招惹五环蛇，她掰了一根树枝，把男人落在身旁的玉盒巴拉到洞口。
五环蛇冷冷的看着李婉的动作，并没有再发起攻击。
李婉见五环蛇没反应，抱起朱火灵果就跑。
她打开男人的玉盒，看着里面九个朱火灵果，拿出一个，用袖子擦了擦，直接送进嘴里。
熟悉的口感从口腔传来，吃过变异朱火灵果，再吃普通朱火灵果后，就很容易能感觉到两者之间的差异。
普通朱火灵果能量太少了，李婉连续吃了五个，吸收的能量可能也才只有昨天那枚变异朱火灵果的一半。
李婉是通过身上出现的黑汗多少和深浅来判断自己吸收的能量多寡。
不过聊胜于无，带来的能量少，总比没有能量的好。
好馋冰洞里的变异朱火灵果啊。

可惜今天老天爷不站在她这边，她打不过五环蛇。
李婉吃完后，仔细的擦了嘴，清理了身上，确定没有任何破绽后，才将男人的玉盒扔回原地，等退出冰洞后，她的手指才在玉盒上连扣三下。
这是遇见变异朱火灵果后，通知花管事的暗语。
发出暗语不过三息，花管事便御空而来，看着冰洞外的李婉，他道，“变异朱火灵果在何处？”
李婉指了指冰洞内，“在里面，不过和我一道来的一个杂役因为想要擅摘变异朱火灵果被五环蛇毒死了。”
花管事冷哼，并不在意死去的杂役，“不自量力。”
他走入冰洞，也不管躺在一侧的杂役男人，只抽出一柄雪白的长剑，对着五环蛇的方向，毫不费力的一刺，五环蛇被轻易地砍成了两节。
刚伤了一条人命，令李婉心惊胆战的五环蛇，就这么轻轻松松被杀死了。
这就是修真者的力量吗？
李婉心中对力量的渴望前所未有的强烈。
她一定要修仙，她也要将一切对她有威胁之物轻易的斩于手下！
就在李婉在流林宗冰原上到处找朱火灵果的时候，地星研究基地也终于取得了一些进展。
符咒小组在拿到更多的试验样品后就加班加点的投入了研究，他们尝试利用机器提取符咒能量变化时的能量。
这是个操作难度极大，失败率极高的试验。
content_en:
Li Wan bent down and picked up a piece of broken ice the size of a palm, aimed in the direction of the five-ringed snake, and hit it accurately on the five-ringed snake.
It was like turning on some kind of switch to start a war.
The five-ringed snake was enraged and flew up very fast, attacking the invading humans.
Because of his excitement, the man was closest to the mutated Vermilion Fire Spirit Fruit and bore the brunt of the Five-ringed Snake's attack.
"Ah!"
The screams suddenly echoed through the ice cave, and the five-ringed snake's fangs instantly pierced the clothes and plunged into the man's strong shoulders.
The poison spread to his internal organs in a matter of seconds. The man's lips turned purple and he collapsed on the ground without being able to make a sound.
The moment the five-ringed snake launched its attack, Li Wan ran out of the ice cave desperately.
After the screams, the ice cave fell into a strange silence. After waiting for a long time, the five-ringed snake was not seen at the entrance of the cave.
Li Wan looked into the ice cave and saw the man lying stiffly in the ice cave, making no sound, while the five-ringed snake continued to coil around the mutated vermilion fire spirit fruit plant.
Almost the second Li Wan showed her head, the five-ringed snake's eyes were locked on her body, and the snake kept spitting out messages and making threatening sounds.
With the man's lesson learned, Li Wan would not provoke the five-ringed snake again. She broke off a branch and pulled the jade box that the man had left beside her to the entrance of the cave.
The five-ringed snake looked at Li Wan's movements coldly and did not attack again.
Seeing that the five-ringed snake didn't respond, Li Wan picked up the Zhuhuo Lingguo and ran away.
She opened the man's jade box, looked at the nine Zhuhuo Lingguo inside, took out one, wiped it with her sleeve, and put it directly into her mouth.
The familiar taste comes from the mouth. After eating the mutant Vermilion Fire Spirit Fruit and then the ordinary Vermilion Fire Spirit Fruit, you can easily feel the difference between the two.
Ordinary Vermilion Fire Spirit Fruits had too little energy. Li Wan ate five of them in a row, and the energy absorbed by them was probably only half of the mutated Vermilion Fire Spirit Fruit yesterday.
Li Wan judges the amount of energy he has absorbed by the amount and depth of black sweat appearing on his body.
But it’s better than nothing, and it brings less energy, which is better than no energy at all.
I'm so greedy for the mutated vermilion fire fruit in the ice cave.
It's a pity that God is not on her side today, and she can't defeat the five-ringed snake.
After Li Wan finished eating, she wiped her mouth carefully and cleaned her body. After making sure there were no flaws, she threw the man's jade box back to where it was. After exiting the ice cave, she clasped the jade box three times with her fingers.
This is the code word used to inform the flower steward after encountering the mutated Vermilion Fire Spirit Fruit.
Within three breaths of uttering the secret message, Manager Hua came from the air. Looking at Li Wan outside the ice cave, he asked, "Where is the mutated vermillion fire spirit fruit?"
Li Wan pointed to the ice cave, "Inside, a handyman who came with me was poisoned by a five-ringed snake because he wanted to pick the mutated red fire spirit fruit."
Manager Hua snorted coldly, not caring about the dead handyman, "You are not overestimating your capabilities."
He walked into the ice cave and ignored the handy man lying on one side. He only pulled out a snow-white long sword and stabbed it effortlessly in the direction of the five-ringed snake. The five-ringed snake was easily cut into two sections.
The five-ringed snake that had just injured a human life and made Li Wan frightened was killed so easily.
Is this the power of a cultivator?
Li Wan's desire for power was stronger than ever.
She must cultivate immortality, and she must easily kill everything that threatens her!
While Li Wan was looking for Zhuhuo Lingguo everywhere on the Liulin Sect Icefield, the Earth Star Research Base finally made some progress.
After getting more test samples, the spell team worked overtime and invested in research. They tried to use machines to extract the energy when the spell energy changes.
This is an experiment that is extremely difficult to operate and has an extremely high failure rate.
